  • The no-code chatbot builder helps teams set up an initial agentic AI bot using a simple prompt. Rule-based steps and API integrations can then be added as needed.
  • For example, a Madrid-based online retailer can use an AI chatbot to answer delivery questions in Spanish and transfer complex return inquiries to a customer service agent.
  • Managers can review ticket volumes, unresolved issues, and customer satisfaction reports.

faqs.question: Which communication channels can Spanish businesses manage through MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello supports shared-inbox workflows across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, X (Twitter), and configured calling services. Apple Messages for Business can also be connected where enabled.
  • Each conversation can be organized as a ticket, keeping customer history, internal notes, and support responsibilities visible.
  • For example, a Barcelona travel agency can answer booking inquiries through website chat, manage itinerary changes through WhatsApp, and respond to emailed cancellations from the same workspace.
  • Agents can also manage customer conversations using the Hello mobile app.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 Hello combine rule-based flows and agentic AI in one chatbot?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello lets businesses combine fixed chatbot steps with conversational agentic AI.
  • Rule-based steps can collect a reservation reference, order number, or preferred service. Agentic AI can then understand follow-up questions and use connected information to provide relevant answers.
  • For example, a Spanish hotel chain can first ask customers for their booking reference and then answer questions about check-in times, room facilities, or reservation policies.
  • The no-code builder supports different AI models, API connections, multilingual responses, and transfer to human agents.
  • Businesses can configure an initial agentic AI chatbot in minutes.

faqs.question: Can multiple agents manage one WhatsApp Business number using MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello lets several authorized agents respond through one connected WhatsApp Business number using individual logins.
  • Managers can assign tickets, organize departments, add private notes, and review the full conversation history.
  • For example, a Spanish furniture company can route product questions to sales, delivery requests to logistics, and return inquiries to customer support.
  • Hello includes unlimited agents across its plans, making it easier to expand teams without paying extra per-agent license fees.
  • Businesses can also manage WhatsApp alongside email, website chat, and social messaging channels.
  • Want to make it easier for customers to contact your business on WhatsApp? Use MSG91's Free WhatsApp Link Generator to create click-to-chat links, QR codes and website chat widgets with optional pre-filled messages. Once your WhatsApp Business channel is connected to MSG91 Hello, your support team can manage customer conversations from the shared inbox.

faqs.question: Can customer support teams in Spain manage calls through MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello offers cloud calling and IVR features within configured customer service workflows.
  • Businesses can organize call routing, direct customers to departments, and maintain relevant call records alongside support tickets.
  • For example, a medical center in Valencia can direct appointment inquiries, administrative questions, and billing requests to the correct teams.
  • The Hello mobile app also supports outbound customer service calls in compatible calling configurations.
  • AI voice assistance can be added to suitable customer experiences, with distinct setup requirements for website voice interactions and telephone-based services.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Chat Window, and how does it reduce WhatsApp support costs?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Chat Window allows customers to start a support conversation on WhatsApp and continue it in a separate chat window linked to Hello.
  • This is useful when resolving detailed questions about refunds, bookings, delivery problems, or technical support.
  • For example, a Spanish electronics retailer can receive a WhatsApp inquiry about a defective item and move the longer troubleshooting conversation into Chat Window.
  • Messages sent within Chat Window do not incur Meta WhatsApp per-message charges.
  • Messages sent on WhatsApp remain subject to the applicable WhatsApp rates.

faqs.question: How is MSG91 Hello different from Zendesk, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, and Intercom?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello offers unlimited agents without individual per-agent license fees, together with omnichannel messaging, AI chatbots, ticket management, and workflow automation.
  • Businesses can combine rule-based and agentic AI in one chatbot, connect external applications through APIs, and continue WhatsApp-originated conversations through Chat Window.
  • For Spanish companies evaluating AI customer support software, Hello provides an alternative to managing messaging, automation, and customer service through separate platforms.
  • Competing products also provide extensive support features, although pricing, AI capabilities, and integration access vary by provider and plan.
